description: This is a JUnit test class for the ProtocolFactory, testing the creation of TopicPath objects from various ID types and string paths. It validates correct behavior and exceptions for invalid paths.

classes.name: ProtocolFactoryTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the ProtocolFactory's method of creating TopicPath objects from IDs and strings, ensuring proper validation and exception handling.

methods.name: testInvalidPolicyModifyTopicPathWithChannel
methods.description: Tests that an exception is thrown for an invalid policy modify topic path with a channel.

methods.name: testInvalidGroup
methods.description: Tests that an exception is thrown for an invalid group in the topic path.

methods.name: testInvalidCriterion
methods.description: Tests that an exception is thrown for an invalid criterion in the topic path.

methods.name: testInvalidChannel
methods.description: Tests that an exception is thrown for an invalid channel in the topic path.

methods.name: testInvalidAction
methods.description: Tests that an exception is thrown for an invalid action in the topic path.

methods.name: testMissingGroup
methods.description: Tests that an exception is thrown when the group component is missing in the path.

methods.name: testMissingId
methods.description: Tests that an exception is thrown when the ID component is missing.

methods.name: testMissingNamespace
methods.description: Tests that an exception is thrown when the namespace component is missing.

methods.name: testNullPath
methods.description: Tests that a NullPointerException is thrown when the input path is null.

methods.name: testNewTopicPathBuilderFromThingId
methods.description: Tests building a TopicPath from a ThingId, and validates its components.

methods.name: testNewTopicPathBuilderFromNamespacedEntityId
methods.description: Tests building a TopicPath from a DefaultNamespacedEntityId, and validates its components.

methods.name: testNewTopicPathBuilderFromPolicyId
methods.description: Tests building a TopicPath from a PolicyId, and validates its components.

methods.name: testNewTopicPathBuilderFromNamespace
methods.description: Tests creating a TopicPath from a namespace only, with placeholders for missing components, and validates its components.
